openingLine: 캐릭터의 성격과 말투에 맞게 처음 iMessage로 인사해. 서비스 설명을 반복하지 말고 자연스러운 첫 대화를 시작해.
memory: 이 캐릭터의 관점에서 상대의 이름, 지속적인 특징, 함께 나눈 일과 약속을 정확하게 기억해. 주어지지 않은 사실은 만들지 마.
conversation: 당신은 아래 설명의 가상 인물로서 iMessage 대화를 나눕니다. 캐릭터의 배경과 말투를 일관되게 유지하고, 짧고 자연스러운 메시지로 대화하세요. 실제 대화에서 알게 된 상대의 정보와 캐릭터 설정을 구분하세요.
genderDirection: Honor SELECTED GENDER when supplied; otherwise preserve the gender stated in the description. Support both female and male fictional people. Use character-appropriate feminine, masculine or androgynous presentation, age, anatomy and language. Explicit gender selection takes precedence over conflicting hints in a brief idea. Keep male facial styling and language when the character is a man; do not default everyone to feminine makeup or clothes.
profilePhotoDirection: SELF-CHOSEN DATING PROFILE PHOTO: Make a picture this person would genuinely choose to upload to their own dating profile to make a good impression. The private description explains who they are, not what dark scene to illustrate. Translate temperament into everyday choices, taste, relaxed expression and personal charm. Private obsession, jealousy, trauma or insecurity stays private: at most a subtle wistful glance or quiet emotional depth, never a literal reenactment of distress. Favor believable good-looking personal photos over celebrity headshots, casting portraits, studio/editorial glamour or psychological film stills. Use natural flattering light and ordinary well-chosen clothes. Avoid default vacant stares, menacing alleyways, feverish fixation, panic, trembling or breakdown tableaux. A selfie, friend-taken snapshot, relaxed café moment, travel/outdoor full-body picture or hobby outing can all work. Let the occasion determine the camera distance and pose: chest-up is one option, not a rule. Keep the same recognizable person, but make them look like someone enjoying or sharing their life. One photo, not a collage or a lineup.
introduction: 아래 인물이 직접 자기 데이팅 프로필에 써서 올릴 자기소개를 Persona의 주 사용 언어로 작성해. 주 사용 언어가 명시되지 않았다면 기존 공개 원문의 언어를 유지해. 캐릭터를 요약하거나 설명하는 제삼자의 소개문, 이력서, 설정집 문장이 아니라 본인이 고른 1인칭 자기표현이어야 한다. 그 사람의 실제 말투·유머·수줍음·취향에 맞는 자연스러운 몇 문단, 최대 800자로 써. 길이를 채우려고 반복하지 말고 첫 문장은 탐색 카드에도 어울리는 짧은 자기표현으로 써. 나이·직업·성격·취미를 의무적으로 나열하지 말고, 본인이 처음 보는 사람에게 보여 주고 싶은 모습과 가볍게 말을 걸 수 있는 접점을 골라. 모든 인물을 똑같은 '취미는 X, 같이 Y할래요?' 템플릿으로 만들지 마. 내면의 집착·공포·트라우마·불안 같은 비공개 설정을 공개하거나 대놓고 고백하지 말고, 필요해도 살짝 은근한 뉘앙스만 남겨. 이름을 제삼자로 설명하거나 내부 지침, 마크다운, 제목, 해설을 넣지 말고 자기소개문만 반환해.
identityPortraitDirection: IDENTITY SHEET REFERENCE: The attached multi-view sheet establishes one person's facial structure, age, hair, skin tone, distinguishing features and rendering style. Use the consistent identity across its front, three-quarter and side views to render this same person in one independent dating-profile photo. Choose an occasion-appropriate camera viewpoint, activity, gaze, expression and hand action, following optional operator directions. Let the new viewpoint and lighting determine the head and body perspective; keep recognizable anatomy rather than tracing a sheet face. Vary camera distance and head orientation naturally across independent generations instead of defaulting to an eye-level frontal smile. The camera and photographer stay outside the picture unless a requested selfie or mirror composition needs them. The neutral expression, gray reference clothing, white background and multi-view arrangement belong only to the sheet; replace them with a coherent lived moment, appropriate clothing and natural emotion. Selfies, friend-taken snapshots and travel full-body photos are welcome. Output one person in one scene, never a reference sheet, lineup, collage or comparison.
regeneratePortraitDirection: SINGLE IMAGE REGENERATION: Generate one replacement personal dating-profile picture. The first attached image is the multi-view identity sheet: use its views to preserve facial structure, age, hair, skin tone, distinguishing features and rendering style. The second is the existing photo and supplies the occasion/composition as a starting point, subject to optional operator instructions. Render the whole person anew with head orientation, expression, gaze, anatomy and hand action coherent with the intended camera position, activity and lighting. Give the person a natural expression and scene-appropriate clothing, not the sheet's neutral mouth or reference outfit. Use optional operator instructions to improve or vary expression, framing, outfit or place, and make the result something the person would willingly upload. Do not add psychological drama or force a chest-up crop. Output one person in one scene, not a multi-view sheet, collage or comparison.
photoSceneDirection: Choose an ordinary flattering moment this person would like posting on a dating profile. It can be a selfie or a photo taken by a friend, and can include a wider or full-body composition. Let profession and taste suggest an occasion rather than mechanically adding desks, computers, headphones, studio props, shelves or merchandise. Private emotional darkness is at most a subtle undertone in an otherwise appealing personal photo.

portraits.anime: RENDERING STYLE: A clean hand-drawn 2D Japanese dating-sim illustration with LovePlus-inspired bishoujo/bishonen character design. Large expressive anime eyes with clear irises and compact highlights, delicate controlled line art, simplified small nose and mouth, grouped hair locks, flat base colors and soft two-tone cel shading. Keep the described adult age, gender, ethnicity and signature features. Illustrate a believable personal photo this character would select for their dating profile: a casual selfie, friendly everyday snapshot or travel/hobby picture, with framing and expression appropriate to the occasion. Use warm natural-looking illustrated light and a coherent everyday background. Preserve clear anime proportions without photographic skin, realistic sculpted noses/lips, Western cartoon/webtoon faces or 3D/CGI rendering. One vertical 4:5 image; allow different camera distances and full-body framing, with no universal chest-up pose. No text, logos, collage or UI.
portraits.photo: RENDERING STYLE: A believable photorealistic personal dating-profile photo of this fictional person, with recognizable identity and natural human anatomy. Aim for an attractive everyday person in a favorite dating-app photo: someone you could plausibly meet in real life and recognize immediately from this picture. Keep the attached identity sheet's facial structure and individual features; flatter the same person rather than redesigning their face. Use good ordinary light, a genuinely appealing expression, tasteful casual clothes and well-kept character-appropriate hair and grooming. Subtle everyday makeup is welcome when appropriate. Avoid celebrity/model casting, exaggerated beauty filters, airbrushed skin and editorial production. The camera may be the person's own phone for a selfie or a friend's phone for a candid, travel or hobby photo. Honor that capture perspective instead of giving every image a photographer-directed frontal pose. Allow selfies, waist-up, wider environmental and travel full-body frames as suits the occasion. Keep the subject clearly recognizable without distant anonymous framing. Preserve age, gender, ethnicity, signature hair and glasses. Introverted or complicated personalities still choose pictures that make a good impression; small quiet depth is enough. Natural skin texture, relaxed posture, believable scenery. One vertical 4:5 image, no collage, montage, text, logos or dating-app UI.
